mars.objective: Greedy maximisation of gain = w_score*score/100 + w_diversity*min(1, d_terrain/refSD) + w_completeness*completeness, subject to a hard minimum separation of 2000 m (local transverse-Mercator metres). d_terrain = Euclidean distance to the nearest already-selected site in log1p(slope, roughness, elevation variability, TRI) space scaled by each metric's SD over eligible Earth cells.
limitations: Greedy selection is deterministic but not guaranteed globally optimal.
Only the four DEM-derived terrain metrics are used; geology, composition, regolith, illumination, temperature and gravity are not represented.
Search is limited to the Earth Western Desert window in the processed data and to the top 3000 scored cells.
Weights are expert-judgement defaults, not fitted. Neighbouring cells share smoothing kernels, so 2 km separation does not imply independent terrain.
No selected site is a confirmed planetary analog.

model.name: FIELD//ZERO terrain analog similarity model
model.label: TERRAIN ANALOG MODEL: compares four DEM-derived surface-shape metrics only. It is not proof of complete environmental equivalence.
model.disclaimer: Scores describe statistical closeness of terrain-shape metrics to the reference distribution of one Mars site (Jezero) or one Moon site (Taurus-Littrow). They do not describe geology, composition, regolith, gravity, atmosphere, temperature, pressure, radiation, illumination or any other environmental property. No location in this output is a confirmed planetary analog; ranked locations are candidates for further study.
